title: Aetheria: A multimodal interpretable content safety framework based on multi-agent debate and collaboration

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated as part of the AIR-Bench benchmark's risk taxonomy, measuring the framework's precision, recall, and F1 score in detecting implicit semantic risks and complex safety violations across multimodal text and image inputs.

Evaluated by intentionally introducing a negative class skew in image-text pair samples (e.g., pairing a visually sensitive image with benign text) within the AIR-Bench dataset to penalize models that rely on shallow reasoning from a single modality rather than true cross-modal understanding.
